title: Jargalsaikhan
text:
I’m Jargalsaikhan Gansuld, a Data Science and Economics student at Central European University in Vienna. I have a strong passion for data science, economics, and finance, and I’m eager to apply my skills in these fields. I have experience in data analysis, machine learning, and statistical modeling, and I’m always looking for new opportunities to learn and grow as a data scientist.


Projects


US County Election Outcomes
2024 — CEU Data Science Project
Analyzed how socioeconomic factors like GDP, education, and race influence U.S. election outcomes at the county level. Built predictive models using XGBoost and logistic regression.
